title: Invariance of the extended singular ideal under equivalence
statement: For α:A→Λ and an R-algebra equivalence e:B≃A, popescuIdeal(α∘e)=popescuIdeal(α) [def-weil-pbc-popescu-resolution].

source.place: Definition 07C5 and Situation 07F7; invariance under algebra equivalence

proof.text: Apply the singular-ideal transport inclusion to e and e inverse, map the latter inclusion by e, and use composition with the inverse to deduce equality of the transported ideals. Compose ideal maps with α and take radicals.

theorem popescuIdeal_comp_equiv
    {R : Type u} {A : Type v} {B : Type w} {Λ : Type*}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [CommRing Λ]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R B] [Algebra R Λ]
    (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) (e : B ≃ₐ[R] A) : popescuIdeal (α.comp e.toAlgHom) =
      popescuIdeal α
